top_news.title: Forward Pass Domain Adaptation (Without Cross-Layer Backpropagation)
top_news.dek: Forward-Pass-Only (FPO) training enables efficient LLM adaptation by eliminating cross-layer backpropagation.
top_news.brief: FPO training achieves 2.7–3.2x the throughput of standard fine-tuning with 40% less peak memory. By avoiding the backward pass through the model body, it maintains performance on off-domain benchmarks while significantly reducing computational overhead, offering a more stable alternative to full-network fine-tuning.
top_news.image_alt: Diagram showing forward-only data flow in a neural network

top_news.title: Run Massive-Scale UMAP in Minutes Using Multiple GPUs—Without Losing Accuracy
top_news.dek: NVIDIA has optimized UMAP for multi-GPU environments, enabling massive-scale dimensionality reduction in minutes without sacrificing accuracy.
top_news.brief: UMAP is essential for exploratory data analysis and feature extraction, but performance degrades as datasets grow. NVIDIA's multi-GPU implementation accelerates the critical kNN graph construction step, allowing developers to maintain iterative workflows on large-scale data without the typical latency penalties.
top_news.image_alt: Visualization of high-dimensional data reduction using UMAP on multi-GPU clusters

top_news.title: Claude Code weekly limits reduce by a third tomorrow
top_news.dek: Claude Code usage limits will return to standard levels on August 20, 2026, following the conclusion of a 50% capacity promotion.
top_news.brief: Anthropic's temporary promotion, which increased weekly usage limits for Pro, Max, and Team plans by 50%, ends on August 19. Users should prepare for a reduction in available capacity starting tomorrow, as limits revert to their baseline levels.
top_news.image_alt: Claude Code interface showing usage limit status

top_news.title: Cloudflare WriteGuard Brings Fine-Grained Security Controls for MCP Servers
top_news.dek: Cloudflare's new WriteGuard tool provides fine-grained security controls for Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers.
top_news.brief: Currently in private beta, WriteGuard allows developers to restrict AI agent access to tools that modify data or perform external actions. This adds a necessary layer of security for MCP-based architectures, moving beyond simple read-only permissions to prevent unauthorized state changes.
top_news.image_alt: Diagram showing Cloudflare WriteGuard mediating between AI agents and MCP servers

primary.title: Learning Discrete Riemannian Metrics for Physical Fields with Cochain-Frame Equivarianc
primary.summary: Physical fields on meshes require a separation between topology and geometry: conservation laws are topological and should be exact, while geometry, material response, and anisotropic coupling must be learned from data. Existing neural surrogates often mix these roles inside unconstrained message passing.
